_meta.source: Ported from ski-platform/apps/web/messages/en.json (slopeAuthor namespace) on 2026-05-08. Keep in sync when ski-platform updates upstream strings.

slopeAuthor.title: Resort Editor
slopeAuthor.selectHint: Click an existing slope / lift / node to load its editor
slopeAuthor.pickHint: Click drops a pin + fetches elevation
slopeAuthor.drawSlopeHint: Click to add vertices, Enter to finish, Esc to cancel
slopeAuthor.drawLiftHint: Click to add vertices, Enter to finish, Esc to cancel
slopeAuthor.editSlopeGeomHint: Selected slope's polyline becomes editable: drag, insert, append, delete vertices
slopeAuthor.editLiftGeomHint: Selected lift's polyline becomes editable: drag, insert, append, delete vertices
slopeAuthor.addNodeHint: Drop a graph node (POI / station / fork)
slopeAuthor.connectNodesHint: Click nodes in sequence → chains edges between them
slopeAuthor.connectNodesPickFirst: Click first node to start chain
slopeAuthor.connectNodesPickSecond: Click next node to extend chain
slopeAuthor.connectNodesNeedGraph: Load a resort with an existing graph first
slopeAuthor.editEdgeHint: Drag a vertex to move. Drag a midpoint to insert. Right-click to delete.
slopeAuthor.editNodeHint: Drag the selected node. Edges follow. Edit kind + altitude in the side panel.
slopeAuthor.editEdgeNoSelection: Pick an edge from the list to start editing.
slopeAuthor.editEdgeDragHint: Drag vertices · drag midpoints to insert · right-click to delete
slopeAuthor.editNodeNoSelection: Pick a node from the list (or the map in Select mode) to start editing.
slopeAuthor.editNodeDragHint: Drag the cyan marker. Connected edges follow the endpoint.
slopeAuthor.nodesPanelHint: Click a node to select. Then switch to Node mode to drag + edit.
slopeAuthor.edgesPanelEmpty: No edges yet — create some in Edge mode first.
slopeAuthor.edgesPanelHint: Click an edge to select. Stays selected when you switch to Edge geom.
slopeAuthor.mergeNodesPromptBody: These two nodes are {distM}m apart. Collapse them into one to keep the graph clean — edges referencing the removed id will be rewired to the kept id.
slopeAuthor.mergeCloseNodesHint: Find the first pair of nodes within 2m of each other and surface a merge prompt.
slopeAuthor.lintPanelHint: Click an issue to jump straight into the fix.
slopeAuthor.lintNodeOrphan: Node {id} is orphan (no edge references it)
slopeAuthor.patchPreviewHint: Everything below ships when you click Save.
slopeAuthor.welcomeStep1: Pick a resort below. The map zooms in with every slope, lift, and routing node already loaded.
slopeAuthor.welcomeStep2: Use the toolbar on the left to switch modes. Each mode tells you what your next map click will do (pick a point, draw a slope, edit a node, etc.).
slopeAuthor.welcomeStep3: When you save, you sign in with GitHub and your edits open a pull request on powder-nomad/open-ski-data for maintainer review.
slopeAuthor.restoreDraftBody: We kept your work in this browser — saved {when}.
slopeAuthor.conflictsHint: Coordinate with these contributors before you save to avoid clobbering their edits.
slopeAuthor.newPlaceHint: New place will appear in the dropdown after merge + index
slopeAuthor.slugHint: Kebab-case. Used as the downstream sourceKey with place slug.
slopeAuthor.deleteSlopeConfirm: Delete slope "{name}"? The patch bundle will drop this record from slopes.json. You can restore it from the list header until you save.
slopeAuthor.deleteLiftConfirm: Delete lift "{name}"? The patch bundle will drop this record from lifts.json. You can restore it from the list header until you save.
slopeAuthor.restoreAllTitle: Undo all deletions in this session
slopeAuthor.slopeListHintSelect: Click a slope on the map or here to select. Switch to ✎ Slope geom in the toolbar to edit its polyline.
slopeAuthor.slopeListHintEditing: Drag a vertex to move. Double-click a segment to insert a vertex. Right-click a vertex to remove. Edits save when you commit the patch below.
slopeAuthor.liftListHintSelect: Click a lift on the map or here. Switch to 🚡 Lift geom in the toolbar to edit its polyline.
slopeAuthor.liftListHintEditing: Drag a vertex to move. Double-click a segment to insert. Right-click to remove.
slopeAuthor.reviewKeys: F flip · T two-way · A confirm · D delete · S cut · J rejoin · N next
slopeAuthor.reviewCutHint: Click the line where it should be cut.
slopeAuthor.reviewJoinHint: To join ends: select a node and drag it onto another node, or onto the middle of a slope.
slopeAuthor.drawHintStart: Start: click a node, click a slope or lift line (it is cut there), or double-click open map for a new node.
slopeAuthor.drawHintBend: Click open map to bend the line ({count} so far). Finish on a node, on a line, or by double-clicking open map for a new end node.
slopeAuthor.joinToggleOffHint: Dragging only moves this node and the ends of its own lines. Hold Shift while dragging to join once.
slopeAuthor.joinToggleOnHint: Dropped on a node, the two become one. Dropped on the middle of a slope, the slope is cut there.

settings.title: Settings
settings.aboutDescription: osd-edit is a community editor for the open-ski-data project — an open dataset of ski resort maps.

graphEditor.title: Slopes and lifts
graphEditor.hintDrawStart: Start: click a node or a line, or double-click the map for a new point.
graphEditor.hintDrawing: Click the map to bend ({count}). End on a node or a line, or double-click for a new end.
graphEditor.hintCut: Click the line where it should be cut.
graphEditor.deleteNode: Delete this point and its lines
graphEditor.edgeHint: Drag the line's points to reshape it. Its ends stay on their points.
graphEditor.joinOff: Dragging only moves this point and the ends of its own lines. Hold Shift to join once.
graphEditor.joinOn: Dropped on a point, the two become one. Dropped on a slope, the slope is cut there.
graphEditor.useCatalogLine: Use the dashed line as it is
graphEditor.redundantWhy: A slope or lift already joins the same two points.
graphEditor.nearPair: Two points {m} m apart, probably one place
graphEditor.name: Name
graphEditor.stranded: {count} pieces you can't be routed to and back from
graphEditor.strandedWhy: Nothing leads onto them, or nothing leads off. Usually a missing link at a lift top or base.
